title: Group chat composer blue styling + membership-tier gated message styles

requirements.summary: Make the group chat composer message input visually blue by default without changing DM input styling.
acceptanceCriteria: In group chats, the message input has a clearly blue visual style (background and/or border and/or focus ring).
In direct messages, the message input styling remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Update the group composer <Input> styling to apply a distinct blue-tinted background/border/focus ring only within GroupConversation (do not change shared Input component or DM ChatWindow).

requirements.summary: Add a group-chat composer style changer (color/effect) with plan-based availability for Free/Pro/Ultra/Ultimate tiers.
acceptanceCriteria: The group composer shows controls to change message style before sending (color and effect).
Free/Normal users can only select Normal color and no special effects beyond None.
Pro users can select Black, Orange, Blue, and Purple colors.
Ultra users can select Skulls and Flames effects (in addition to prior unlocked options).
Ultimate users can select Dodge effect (in addition to prior unlocked options).

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated group-composer style picker component that renders color and effect options, supports selecting unlocked options, and surfaces locked options per membership tier (UI-only; no backend changes).
Replace/extend the existing cycle buttons with the new GroupComposerStylePicker and ensure the selected MessageColor/MessageEffect values are passed to sendGroupMessage for group chats.
Add small frontend utilities to compare membership tiers (Free/Pro/Ultra/Ultimate) and to compute which colors/effects are unlocked for a tier.

requirements.summary: Show locked styles in the group composer with plan labels and display an English toast explaining the required plan when clicked.
acceptanceCriteria: Locked color/effect options are clearly marked with the required plan label in English.
Attempting to use a locked option does not change the selected style and shows an English explanation/toast indicating the required plan.

file_operations.description: Implement locked-option behavior: render locked options as visible but non-selectable, show required plan label text (e.g., "Pro", "Ultra", "Ultimate"), and on click show an English toast explaining which plan is required while keeping the current selection unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure group messages can send and render Blue/Purple colors and the Dodge effect consistently in the UI while keeping existing styles working.
acceptanceCriteria: Sending a group message with Purple or Blue selected results in recipients seeing the correct color styling on the message bubble text.
Sending a group message with Dodge selected results in recipients seeing a distinct (lightweight) Dodge effect rendering for that message.
Existing message styling (Normal/Black/Orange/Cyan and existing effects) continues to work.

file_operations.description: Extend message style helpers to support MessageColor.blue and MessageColor.purple labels/classes, and add lightweight UI rendering support for MessageEffect.dodge (e.g., a distinct class/decor indicator) while preserving existing mappings and normalization.
Update group message rendering to apply the updated color/effect helpers (including Blue/Purple text colors and Dodge effect rendering) for messages fetched from the backend.
Update direct message rendering to use the updated messageStyle helpers so Blue/Purple/Dodge (if present in DM history) also render correctly without changing DM composer styling defaults.

requirements.summary: Determine the current user’s plan tier on the frontend using existing premium membership data, defaulting unauthenticated/no-profile users to Free/Normal.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend can reliably determine the current user’s plan tier and use it to gate available chat styles in group chat.
Unauthenticated users or users without a profile are treated as Free/Normal for gating purposes.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook for reading the current user’s MembershipTier (using existing backend capabilities available via the actor) with safe fallback to Free when unauthenticated or when tier cannot be determined.
Use the new membership-tier hook to gate which style options are unlocked in the group composer while keeping locked options visible (Free/Normal fallback when identity/profile is unavailable).

requirements.summary: Default group composer selected message color to Blue (including after send/reset) while preserving DM defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening a group conversation, the selected composer message color defaults to Blue.
After sending a group message, the composer selection resets back to Blue (not Normal).
Direct message composer behavior is unchanged.

file_operations.description: Change initial group composer state so messageColor defaults to MessageColor.blue, and update the post-send reset logic to reset back to Blue (and effect to None) for group chats only.
